status.en: 10 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, 23% fewer than the week before, most of them in Baghdad, Erbil and Sulaymaniyah.
status.nb: 10 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, 23 prosent færre enn uken før, flest i Baghdad, Erbil og Sulaymaniyah.

summary.en: Iraqi security forces are moving to Jurf al-Sakhr and Jurf al-Nasr, deploying reinforcements and preparing a senior meeting on oil-smuggling investigations, while security chiefs press the crackdown and the prime minister’s special force and energy police target pipelines. Kataib Hezbollah rejects the oil probe findings, accuses the prime minister of yielding to US and Gulf pressure, and faces an end-of-week deadline to vacate the area, with al-Zaidi threatening force to assert control. Bahrain has accused Iran of attacking its territory in retaliation for US actions, linking regional tensions to the Iraqi smuggling crackdown. 396 battle-related deaths were recorded in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Irakiske sikkerhetsstyrker flytter til Jurf al-Sakhr og Jurf al-Nasr, sender forsterkninger og forbereder et seniormøte om etterforskning av oljesmugling, mens sikkerhetsjefene presser på med nedslagene og statsministerens spesialstyrke og energipolitiet retter seg mot rørledninger. Kataib Hezbollah avviser funnene i oljeundersøkelsen, anklager statsministeren for å gi etter for press fra USA og Gulf, og står overfor en frist på slutten av uken for å forlate området, mens al-Zaidi truer med makt for å hevde kontroll. Bahrain har anklaget Iran for å ha angrepet deres territorium som gjengjeldelse for amerikanske handlinger, og knytter regionale spenninger til den irakiske smuglingsnedslaget. 396 kamprelaterte dødsfall ble registrert i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.extract: The Iraqi conflict is a series of violent events that began with the 2003 American-led invasion of Iraq and deposition of Iraqi dictator Saddam Hussein, followed by a series of conflicts including the protracted Iraq War (2003–2011), the Iraqi insurgency (2011–2013), the War in Iraq (2013–2017), and most recently, the small-scale Islamic State insurgency in 4 provinces located in Northern Iraq since 2017.
